The '''AL-5 Assault Droid''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] in [[3637 BBY]] it assisted the Revanites [[Rarrook]] and [[Marko Ka]] who tried to stop a strike team from reaching the [[Jammer/Legends|signal jammer]] on the [[Razorback Island]], but failed and were killed along with the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
AL-5 Assault Droids appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
